answers.core: It should be core because the regex class is core and the regex class knows best how to escape for the regular expressions it  supports.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around with a few lines of script. Whether it will be used often depends on the use case, but it's really a standard function of every programming language offering regular expressions so it would be nice to have in GDScript as well.

title: Provide a static `escape` function for `RegEx` class
